# glyhub

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/glycoverse/glyhub/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/glycoverse/glyhub)
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of glyhub is to provide curated glycomics and glycoproteomics datasets in literature and databases.

## Installation

You can install the development version of glyhub from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("glycoverse/glyhub")
```
